description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineClientMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineClient' interface, used for testing media pipeline client interactions in the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for various media event notifications.

classes.name: MediaPipelineClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineClient interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of media duration.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of current media position.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of native video size and aspect ratio.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of network state changes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of video data availability.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of audio data availability.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mock method to simulate request for additional media data.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mock method to simulate cancellation of media data request.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of QoS information.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of buffer underflow event.
